notes.title: Performance and Localization
notes.notes:
While I was planning out my next game, I figured I could localize this one so more people can play it.

I wanted to do performance fixes as well since a lot of people had issues with that.
To get noticeable improvements, I had to cut both dynamic weather and lighting. 
The game looks a bit different for it, but runs a lot better now. 

Also, Tomboy Adventure 2 has been announced! Right now I am aiming for a release in Q1 2025. I doubt I will hit that deadline but I will try! 
Wishlist here! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2896630/Tomboy_Adventure_2/

notes.title: Quest version!
notes.notes:
First off, my apologies for taking so long to update anything. I had started development on my next game, leaving no space to update Tomboy Adventure. Once that was finished, I figured I could do a quest version for TA using the things I had learned. It supports Quest 2 and Quest 3.

To get it working I had to cut both dynamic weather and lighting. The game looks a bit worse for it, but runs a lot better now.

There is one problem though: Steam doesn't allow apk downloads! So right now I am distributing the game through Itch. 

If you want to play on a Quest (standalone) and already got a steam version, let me know in the discord channel for the game ([url=https://discord.com/invite/GjnT5UXEfa]https://discord.com/invite/GjnT5UXEfa[/url]). I'll send you a download key!
